description: This file defines a Summernote plugin for inserting special characters via a dialog interface, including UI setup, character data, and keyboard navigation.

methods.name: makeSpecialCharSetTable
methods.description: Creates an HTML table of special characters for selection.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin dialog with the special characters table.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the special characters dialog and inserts selected character.

methods.name: showSpecialCharDialog
methods.description: Handles the dialog UI, keyboard navigation, and selection of special characters.
